description: Executable task queue. Procedure: docs/execution/AUTONOMOUS_WORKFLOW.md. A task is READY when status is 'todo', owner is 'worker', and every dependsOn task is 'done'. Workers take the first ready task in array order.

milestone.name: Foundation
milestone.goal: A clean monorepo (apps/web Next.js, apps/api NestJS) with working gates (format, lint, typecheck, unit, e2e, build), localization, design tokens, PWA shell, and CI, as defined by ADR-0001. No product features.

tasks.title: Owner accepts ADR-0001 and prepares the machine
tasks.goal: Unblock autonomous work with an accepted foundation decision and the required runtime.
scope: Review docs/architecture/decisions/0001-initial-application-foundation.md; set Status to Accepted (or request changes)
Update the ADR index in docs/architecture/decisions/README.md accordingly
Install Node.js 24 LTS on the development machine (node --version prints v24.x)
acceptanceCriteria: ADR-0001 status is Accepted
node --version prints v24.x

tasks.title: Repository baseline and governance commit
tasks.goal: Version the approved governance and establish repository hygiene files.
scope: Add .gitignore (node_modules, build outputs such as .next/ and dist/, coverage, Playwright reports, OS/editor files, .env and .env.* with an exception for .env.example)
Add .gitattributes (text=auto, LF line endings)
Add .editorconfig (UTF-8, LF, 2-space indent, final newline)
Add .nvmrc pinned to Node 24
Commit the existing untracked governance (CLAUDE.md, .claude/, docs/) together with these files
acceptanceCriteria: git status is clean after the commit
git check-ignore .env succeeds; git check-ignore .env.example fails (not ignored)
All governance files are tracked

tasks.title: pnpm workspace root and TypeScript base config
tasks.goal: A workspace root that apps and packages plug into.
scope: Activate pnpm via Corepack; pin the current stable pnpm in root package.json packageManager
Root package.json: private, engines.node for Node 24, no dependencies beyond what this task needs
pnpm-workspace.yaml with apps/* and packages/*
tsconfig.base.json with the strict options listed in ADR-0001 §2
Generate and commit pnpm-lock.yaml
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds
tsconfig.base.json contains strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitOverride, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch

tasks.title: Prettier and base ESLint at the root
tasks.goal: Deterministic formatting and linting before any application code exists.
scope: Prettier config and .prettierignore (exclude lockfile, build outputs, generated files)
ESLint flat config at the root with typescript-eslint recommended rules; structured so apps can add their own rules
Root scripts: format, format:check, lint
Format existing files only if Prettier changes are limited to formatting (Markdown docs may be excluded if formatting would churn them; decide and record in PROGRESS)
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm format:check passes
pnpm lint passes
QUALITY_GATES.md command table lists format:check and lint as existing

tasks.title: Scaffold apps/web (Next.js)
tasks.goal: A minimal, boilerplate-free Next.js app that passes all gates.
scope: Create apps/web with the official create-next-app non-interactively: TypeScript, App Router, src/ directory, Tailwind, ESLint, pnpm; no nested git repo and no nested lockfile
Remove template content: demo page markup, demo images/SVGs, template fonts, template CSS beyond the Tailwind import
tsconfig extends ../../tsconfig.base.json
Integrate Next.js, React Hooks and jsx-a11y lint rules into the root ESLint config; remove the app-local duplicate config if redundant
Scripts in apps/web: dev, build, start, lint, typecheck (tsc --noEmit); root typecheck and build scripts run across workspaces
The root page renders a bare <main> landmark with no user-facing text (text arrives with localization in F-06)
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter web build succeeds
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck and pnpm format:check pass at the root
No template/demo assets remain
The Next.js version used is recorded in PROGRESS.md

tasks.title: Scaffold apps/api (NestJS) with a health endpoint
tasks.goal: A minimal NestJS app with strict TypeScript and real tests.
scope: Create apps/api with the official Nest CLI using pnpm, skipping git init
tsconfig extends ../../tsconfig.base.json plus the decorator options NestJS needs; strict mode on
Remove the hello-world AppController/AppService; add GET /health returning {"status":"ok"}
Port from the PORT environment variable with a documented default (3001); add apps/api/.env.example if any variable is introduced
Use the root ESLint/Prettier configs; delete Nest-generated duplicates
Vitest unit test for the health controller and the generated Vitest e2e test adapted to /health
Scripts: dev, build, start, test, test:e2e, typecheck; included in root lint/typecheck/test/build
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter api test and pnpm --filter api test:e2e pass
pnpm --filter api build succeeds
Root lint, typecheck and format:check pass
The NestJS version used is recorded in PROGRESS.md

tasks.title: Localization foundation (next-intl, uz/ru/en)
tasks.goal: Every page is served under /uz, /ru or /en with the correct html lang, and no hard-coded interface strings.
scope: Install and configure next-intl following its documentation for the installed Next.js version
Locales uz (Uzbek Latin), ru, en; default uz; locale prefix always; / redirects by Accept-Language with uz fallback
<html lang> matches the active locale
Message catalogs apps/web/messages/{uz,ru,en}.json
The root page shows only the working product name from the catalogs (key app.name, value 'IELTS Prep' in all locales; the product name is TBD, so flag it in PROGRESS)
outOfScope: any other copy or product UI
acceptanceCriteria: /uz, /ru and /en render with matching html lang
/ redirects to a locale
All catalogs have identical keys
All gates pass
validation: start the production build and curl -sI /, /uz, /ru, /en
docsToUpdate: docs/product/LOCALIZATION.md (technical section: library, catalog location, routing)

tasks.title: Web unit test tooling (Vitest + Testing Library)
tasks.goal: Unit and component testing for apps/web, with a first test that protects a real rule.
scope: Vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom (and the React plugin) for apps/web
First test: message catalogs uz/ru/en have identical key sets and no empty values
apps/web test script; root test script runs all workspace tests (web and api, both Vitest)
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test runs web and api tests and passes
Removing a key from one catalog makes the test fail (verified once, then reverted)

tasks.title: End-to-end tooling (Playwright + axe), mobile first
tasks.goal: Smoke-level e2e and automated accessibility checks against the production build.
scope: Playwright in apps/web with projects: mobile Chromium (~360x800, primary) and desktop Chromium (1280x800)
Install Chromium for Playwright; if system dependencies require installing OS packages, STOP and ask the owner
Tests: / redirects to a locale; /uz, /ru, /en render with correct html lang; @axe-core/playwright reports no violations on each locale page
Root script test:e2e (builds/starts the web app via Playwright webServer)
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test:e2e passes for both projects

tasks.title: Design tokens, fonts and token enforcement
tasks.goal: The design system exists in code as the single source of visual values.
scope: One Tailwind v4 @theme token file in apps/web transcribing DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: approved brand palette, neutrals, skill colors, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, motion
Remove Tailwind's default color palette so only token colors exist
Base styles: surface.base background, ink text, 16px minimum body, visible focus style, prefers-reduced-motion handling
Manrope and Literata via next/font with latin, latin-ext and cyrillic subsets, exposed as CSS variables

Verify that the shipped Manrope/Literata files contain U+02BB, U+02BC and Cyrillic glyphs (inspect the font cmap or render a test string in Playwright); record the result in PROGRESS. If coverage is missing, STOP and ask (design decision)
Token check script (run by root lint) that fails on raw hex/rgb/hsl colors and arbitrary color utilities outside the token file and the documented platform-metadata exception
acceptanceCriteria: Token values match DESIGN_SYSTEM.md exactly
A raw color added to a component makes pnpm lint fail (verified once, then reverted)
Font glyph coverage result recorded
All gates including test:e2e pass
docsToUpdate: docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (status note: path of the token source in code)

tasks.title: PWA foundation (manifest + app-shell service worker)
tasks.goal: The app is installable and caches its shell; no offline data.
scope: app/manifest.ts with working name, start_url, display standalone, theme/background colors mirroring tokens (documented platform-metadata exception)
Temporary placeholder icons (192, 512, maskable) clearly marked as placeholders in PROGRESS; final icons are an owner asset
Service worker: Serwist if it supports the installed Next.js version and bundler, otherwise a minimal hand-written worker per the official Next.js PWA guide; record the choice and reason in PROGRESS
App-shell caching only; service worker disabled in development
e2e test: manifest is served and valid; service worker registers in the production build
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest and service worker e2e tests pass
All gates pass

tasks.title: Gate consolidation, CI and governance sync
tasks.goal: One command validates everything; CI runs it; governance describes the real setup.
scope: Root check script: format:check, lint (including token check), typecheck, test

GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml): Node from .nvmrc, pnpm via Corepack, install --frozen-lockfile, check, build on push and pull_request. Do NOT push; CI activates when the owner pushes
QUALITY_GATES.md: final command table; mark implemented items in 'Future deterministic enforcement'
CLAUDE.md: Current state and Commands sections reflect reality
ARCHITECTURE.md: move ADR-0001 items to Confirmed (if accepted)
BOUNDARIES.md: concrete apps/web, apps/api, packages/* rules; add ESLint import restrictions so apps never import from each other
Narrow .claude/rules path globs (security → apps/api/**, etc.) to the real layout
README.md: short project description, prerequisites (Node 24, Corepack), the check command, pointer to CLAUDE.md and docs/
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm check and pnpm build pass from a clean install
An import from apps/api inside apps/web fails lint (verified once, then reverted)
All governance references to commands and layout are accurate
